proposed_templates.format:
ROW values cannot be compared using {operator}; consider using 'IS NOT DISTINCT FROM' (or its shorthand '<=>') instead.
{citation}
proposed_templates.parameter_contract: EQUALS branch; operator is uppercased and single-quoted; citation is ROW_DOCUMENTATION.

proposed_templates.format:
ROW values cannot be compared using {operator}; consider using 'IS DISTINCT FROM' instead.
{citation}
proposed_templates.parameter_contract: NOT_EQUALS branch; operator is uppercased and single-quoted; citation is ROW_DOCUMENTATION.

proposed_templates.format:
'NULLIF' compares ROW values for equality; consider using 'CASE WHEN x IS NOT DISTINCT FROM y THEN NULL ELSE x END' instead.
{citation}

ROW values cannot be compared using {operator}; compare their fields instead.
{citation}
proposed_templates.parameter_contract: Ordering/min/max cases with isRow=true; operator is uppercased and single-quoted; citation is ROW_DOCUMENTATION.

proposed_templates.format:
ARRAY and MAP values that contain ROW values cannot be compared using {operator}.
{citation}
proposed_templates.parameter_contract: Ordering/min/max cases with isRow=false and hasRow=true; citation is ROW_DOCUMENTATION.
